notes.title: Two Days Until Gunpowder's Release!
notes.notes: Greetings everyone and thank you all for checking out Gunpowder, our western themed and explosive puzzle game. Gunpowder is going to be releasing in two days, on July 8th, and we cannot be more excited to share the game with everyone on PC, Mac and Linux. For the first week of release we are going to be selling at it at a 15% discount ($8.49). Feel free to head on over to the forums to talk to us about anything related to Gunpowder and we hope you love the game.
